questions.question: When people were amazed at Jesus' learning at the feast, where did He say His teaching comes from?

answers.text: From the One who sent Him
From years of reading the Scriptures

questions.question: When people in the temple courts tried to seize Jesus, no one laid a hand on Him. Why not?

answers.text: His hour had not yet come
The priests told them to wait
His disciples stood in the way

questions.question: When the Pharisees heard the crowd whispering about Jesus, what did they and the chief priests do?

answers.text: Asked Him to teach them more
Ordered the crowd to go home

questions.question: Jesus told the people in the temple courts that they would look for Him and find Him. True or false?
